description: This file defines the Contact class in SuiteCRM, extending the Person template and implementing EmailInterface. It encapsulates contact-related data fields, relationships, and methods for querying, listing, and synchronizing contact information within the application.

classes.name: Contact
classes.description: Represents a contact entity with methods for data management, relationship handling, and querying within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: add_list_count_joins
methods.description: Adds necessary JOIN clauses to the query for related account data.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Helps determine access control for listing views based on ACL permissions.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Constructs SQL queries for listing contacts, handling special actions like address popups.

methods.name: address_popup_create_new_list_query
methods.description: Creates a SQL query specifically for address popup views, including necessary JOINS and select columns.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Builds a SQL statement to export contact data, including related email and account info.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Populates extra fields like full name and email address formatting for list views.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Retrieves detailed related account, report-to contact, and campaign info for a contact.

methods.name: load_contacts_users_relationship
methods.description: Loads the relationship to sync contacts with users for Outlook or similar integrations.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares contact data for presentation in list views, including sync status and email formatting.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Constructs a flexible WHERE clause for searching contacts based on a query string.

methods.name: set_notification_body
methods.description: Assigns contact details to notification templates.

methods.name: get_contact_id_by_email
methods.description: Retrieves contact ID based on email address.

methods.name: save_relationship_changes
methods.description: Handles updates to account-contact relationships during save operations.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates support for certain interfaces like ACL.

methods.name: get_unlinked_email_query
methods.description: Provides a query to find emails not linked to any contact.

methods.name: process_sync_to_outlook
methods.description: Syncs the contact to Outlook by associating with users based on a list.
